description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling 'Meal' related actions within the application. It includes a 'base' method that sets up a meal object in the stash based on an ID parameter, and is part of a chained action setup.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Meal
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing 'Meal' related actions, extending the base controller.
